blockingFindings.title: R1 Does Not Cover Result Recording Completion
blockingFindings.rationale: R1 explicitly requires both canonical advisory recording and completed result_recording, but the executable test only covers canonicalization.
blockingFindings.issue: The R1 test only constructs canonical findings through ReviewDisposition and asserts advisory ID/count. It does not exercise the result_recording path or assert that result_recording completes for a draft-questions repairTargets-only artifact.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local assertion path for R1 that records the draft-questions repairTargets-only artifact through the result_recording mechanism and verifies completion.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R1 explicitly requires both canonical advisory recording and completed result_recording, but the executable test only covers canonicalization.

blockingFindings.title: R3 Preservation Is Only Counted, Not Verified
blockingFindings.rationale: An implementation could drop or rewrite the actual advisory input content while preserving only count and IDs, and this test would still pass without validating the required preservation behavior.
blockingFindings.issue: The R3 test asserts no blocking findings, total advisory count, and fallback IDs, but it does not assert that the advisoryFindings and repairTargets input content is preserved in the canonical advisory findings.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Assert the canonical advisory findings retain the input advisory and repair-target content needed by the contract, such as title, target/evidence/rationale where present, and category/classification semantics.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An implementation could drop or rewrite the actual advisory input content while preserving only count and IDs, and this test would still pass without validating the required preservation behavior.

requirements.desc: A draft-questions repairTargets-only artifact shall record each repair target once as a canonical advisory finding and complete result_recording.
A draft-coverage repairTargets-only artifact shall use the same canonical advisory contract.
advisoryFindings and repairTargets shall both be preserved as advisory inputs without producing blocking findings.
Repair targets shall retain category=repair_target, target, evidence, and rationale in review history and remain available to the existing triage route.
An artifact with all finding buckets empty shall remain PASS with zero canonical findings.
ADVISORY with blocking findings, PASS with findings, and REJECTED without blocking findings shall continue to fail closed.
Multiple distinct draft findings shall receive unique deterministic fallback findingId values while duplicate content fingerprints and duplicate review evidence remain rejected.
An Issue #453 checkpoint-shaped repair-target artifact shall be processed once and advance through canonical recording to triage without invoking review AI.
